hunks.sol: “It’s as fearsome as I heard, this Temporary Strength Pill.”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t be so surprised. We’ve never practiced demonic martial arts in our lives. To take this, we had to pay a price.”
hunks.sol: “No need to look so surprised. None of us has ever practiced demonic martial arts. We had to pay a price to take it.”

hunks.baseline: The Temporary Strength Pill was a power usually reserved for those who practiced demonic, heterodox arts—especially those whose skill was incomplete and who had not reached Supreme Peak.
hunks.sol: The Temporary Strength Pill’s power was chiefly for practitioners of demonic, heterodox arts—particularly those whose martial arts remained incomplete because they had not reached Supreme Peak.

hunks.baseline: So even if those who practiced righteous energy got their hands on one of the spare pills carried by Dark Heaven’s followers and took it, it wouldn’t have much effect.
hunks.sol: Even if someone who cultivated pure qi took one of the spare pills carried by Dark Heaven’s followers, it would have little effect.

hunks.baseline: There was only one way.
To break the innate qi they’d built up over more than eighty years, forcing themselves to absorb the energy in the pill.
hunks.sol: Unless they did something mad: broke the innate qi they had built up over more than eighty years and forced themselves to absorb the pill’s energy.

hunks.baseline: Unless they did something mad like that.
Whoooom.
hunks.sol: *Whoooom.*

hunks.baseline: His voice trailed off amid a deep rumble.
hunks.sol: His words faded beneath a deep rumble.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, a restless, pale Force—undeniably Force—covered the sword in Perfected One Taecheong’s hand.
hunks.sol: An unstable, hazy Force gathered around the sword in Perfected One Taecheong’s hand. There was no mistaking what it was.

hunks.baseline: No. It surged up along the swords of all five Kunlun Five Immortals.
hunks.sol: And it wasn’t his sword alone. Force rose from the blades of all five Kunlun Five Immortals.

hunks.baseline: “If that’s what it takes, then we’ll gladly become monsters, too.”
hunks.sol: “We’ll gladly become monsters ourselves.”

hunks.baseline: At that moment—
Whoosh!
hunks.sol: *Whoosh!*

hunks.baseline: Space split, and six figures clashed in a tangle.
hunks.sol: Space split, and six figures clashed.

hunks.baseline: That was all the time the Kunlun Five Immortals could stay on their feet.
hunks.sol: That was all the time the Kunlun Five Immortals remained on their feet.

hunks.baseline: But to someone else, it was a full fifteen minutes.
hunks.sol: But for someone else, they had bought a full fifteen minutes.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps that was why Perfected One Taecheong could smile even through the distant pain of having both his legs torn off.
hunks.sol: Perhaps that was why Perfected One Taecheong could smile even through the overwhelming pain as both his legs were torn off.

hunks.baseline: Slice!
hunks.sol: *Slice!*

hunks.baseline: Why he could swallow his screams as his arms were cut off.
hunks.sol: Then his arms were severed.

hunks.baseline: Boom!
hunks.sol: *Boom!*
Even as the organs inside him tore apart, he swallowed his screams.

hunks.baseline: Why, even as his internal organs were torn apart, the old Daoist could hold to his Daoist principles and offer a final farewell to his Junior Brothers, who had already stopped breathing.
hunks.sol: And when the shadow of death finally fell over him, the old Daoist held fast to his principles and offered a last farewell to his Junior Brothers, whose breathing had already ceased.

hunks.baseline: CRACK!
hunks.sol: *Crack!*

hunks.baseline: His brain matter burst out with a horrible pop.
hunks.sol: Brain matter sprayed with a horrible sound.

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord lifted his foot from Perfected One Taecheong’s shattered head and whispered coldly.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord lifted his foot from Perfected One Taecheong’s shattered head.

hunks.baseline: “No. This is a meaningless death.”
hunks.sol: “No,” he whispered coldly. “You died for nothing.”

hunks.baseline: As he slowly raised his head, he heard a roar from all around him—louder and closer than ever.
hunks.sol: As he slowly raised his head, cries sounded from every direction, louder and closer than before.

hunks.baseline: No. It was a creed of exactly eight characters.
hunks.sol: No. They were a creed of exactly eight characters.

hunks.baseline: Above heaven and below heaven, ten thousand demons bow in homage.
hunks.sol: *Heaven above and earth below; All demons bow!*

hunks.baseline: Above heaven and below heaven, let all things kneel.
hunks.sol: Above the heavens, beneath the heavens—let all things kneel.

hunks.baseline: “……So it shall be.”
hunks.sol: “……And so they shall.”

hunks.baseline: Leaving those low words behind, the monster continued toward the Inner City.
hunks.sol: The monster walked on toward the Inner City, sticky blood trailing with him.

hunks.baseline: With sticky blood at his feet.
